mechanism_match_basis.composition_primitive: One edge-to-edge landscape frame; centered brand/proposition overlay; fixed-height lower news strip follows the media; persistent compact top navigation.
mechanism_match_basis.visual_hierarchy: Brand wordmark small; proposition centered at medium relative scale; thin white type over darker region; secondary text smaller; top nav compact.
mechanism_match_basis.typography_observation: Brand wordmark small; proposition centered at medium relative scale; thin white type over darker region; secondary text smaller; top nav compact.
mechanism_match_basis.media_observation: Wide garden photograph as the dominant canvas; crop preserves landscape and water as the focal field; overlaid text remains within the image; no asset-layer inference beyond observed render.
mechanism_match_basis.spatial_rhythm: Large uninterrupted image scene followed by narrow information strip; surrounding viewport density low.
mechanism_match_basis.responsive_recomposition: Hero changes to narrow portrait crop; proposition remains over media at smaller scale; compact header; news strip remains as next band.
mechanism_match_basis.implementation_boundary: DOM: logo, proposition, navigation, news strip, links. Image asset: landscape photograph with responsive object-position variants. CSS: overlay and contrast gradient only if needed for verified contrast; no text baked into image.
misuse_constraints: Requires licensed high-resolution environment photography with a quiet text-safe area.
Do not place text over busy focal details without an independently tested contrast treatment.
Short proposition copy preferred; mobile crop must preserve focal subject and text zone.
